sn46.16:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā rājagahe viharati veḷuvane kalandakanivāpe.
sn46.16:1.2: tena kho pana samayena bhagavā ābādhiko hoti dukkhito bāḷhagilāno.
sn46.16:1.3: atha kho āyasmā mahācundo yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho āyasmantaṃ mahācundaṃ bhagavā etadavoca:
sn46.16:2.1: sattime bhante, bojjhaṅgā bhagavatā sammadakkhātā bhāvitā bahulīkatā abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattanti.
sn46.16:2.3: satisambojjhaṅgo kho bhante, bhagavatā sammadakkhāto bhāvito bahulīkato abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattati -pe- upekhāsambojjhaṅgo kho bhante, bhagavatā sammadakkhāto bhāvito bahulīkato abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattati.
sn46.16:2.4: ime kho bhante, satta bojjhaṅgā bhagavatā sammadakkhātā bhāvitā bahulīkatā abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattantīti.
sn46.16:3.4: tathā pahīno ca bhagavato so ābādho ahosīti.
